title: Replication Package: When Does Raising Mutation Score Actually Raise Real-Fault Detection? An Empirical Investigation on Java Ecosystems
description: Replication package and empirical artifact accompanying the paper 'When Does Raising Mutation Score Actually Raise Real-Fault Detection? An Empirical Investigation on Java Ecosystems'. Includes mined real-world regression bug fixes in Apache Commons Lang, PITest execution logs, method-level test annotation isolation harnesses, non-parametric statistical analysis scripts, and 300 DPI publication figures.
